g.text: Standard Test: 1,036 queries (544 positive / 492 negative), 101 thresholds. Dotted vertical line / large marker: protocol threshold 0.4.
Checkpoints were selected only by Val mAP. Joint GMR + GEQ and D-GMR use identical GEQ presence scores; their G-mIoU difference reflects proposal reranking and PAT-Select.
